world_rationale: Reviewed all59 added recipes, all36 new concept descriptions and the complete progression; byte-compared and explicitly inherited57 unchanged reviewed baseline recipes. The expansion adds19 crafted outputs plus17 supplied concepts, preserves old rules/goals/starters/milestones, and reuses seven previously terminal discoveries. All new supplies have uses and unlock without extra actions at30/36 earned crafts. The supplied crumb ingredient avoids the rejected non-inferable bread-plus-oven shortcut. Explicit preparation text makes broad culinary associations understandable; meat/rice soup and some pastries remain plausible canonical game choices rather than exclusive culinary consequences. New definitions are concise, with Mucenici regional forms corrected. No adult framing, alcohol dependency or disrespectful religious framing. Compatibility binds actual reviewed historical mechanics and must preserve every earned old concept. No claim of human playtesting.
